title: Rating Plausibility of Word Senses through Narrative Understanding
description: SemEval-2026 Task 5: rating how plausible a particular sense of an ambiguous word is within a short narrative. Each item is a 4-5 sentence story containing a homonym in a target sentence, with sparse contextual cues. Annotators judge, on a 1-5 scale, how plausible a given candidate sense of the homonym is in that narrative context. Built on the Ambistory dataset.
